name: Vector

skills.name: Depressive Mentality
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 7 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name:
Dead End Meltdown
(Active / Targeted / Debuff)
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 7 tile radius and deals Burn damage equivalent to 120% ATK to it. If the target has Burn type debuffs, deals fixed damage equivalent to 50% ATK to the target and all enemies within a 3 tile radius of it, and applies Overburn for 2 turns. Vector gains 2 points of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Portent of Doom
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 7 tile radius and deals Burn damage equivalent to 100% ATK to it, and applies Smolder for 2 turns. Vector gains 2 points of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Searing Finale
skills.description: Selects a tile within a 7 tile radius, deals AoE Burn damage equivalent to 60% ATK to all enemies and generates Incineration tiles that lasts for 2 turns within a 7 tile radius of the designated tile. Applies Accelerant to all allies for 2 turns. Vector gains Extra Command.

skills.name: Perception Block
skills.description:
Vector is immune from the negative effects of Burn tiles.

Before dealing Burn damage, if the target has Overburn, applies Overheat Combustion on the target for 2 turns

At the start of the battle, increases the attack count of Support attack that deals Burn damage by 1

At the start of each turn, if Vector's Confectance Index is full, Vector consumes all points of Confectance Index, and increases ATK by 10% until the end of the round.

fortification.effect: New effect is added for Overheat Combustion - Increases Burn damage taken by 30%, fixed damage is dealt to all enemies within a 3x3 tile radius of the target, and increases the attack count of Support attack that deals Burn damage by 2 instead.

Enhances the effect for Accelerant - When dealing Burn damage, increases damage dealt by 20% (from 10% to 30%).

Applies Blazing Assault II to all allied units for 2 turns, and cleanses 2 debuffs for all allies.

Increases damage multiplier of Burn and fixed damage by 30%.

The target does not need to have Burn type debuff to deal fixed damage. Additionally applies Overheat Combustion on the target for 2 turns.

Vector gains 2 more points of Confectance Index.

Increases damage multiplier by 30%

New effect is added for Smolder - for each Burn type debuff held, increases damage taken by 3%

Applies Overheat for 1 turn. Vector gains 2 more points of Confectance Index.

New effect is added for Overheat Combustion - At the end of the action, generates Incineration tiles within a 1 tile radius of self. The fixed damage multiplier is increased by 10%.

At the start of each turn, for each excess Confectance Index point above the maximum, increases ATK by 10%, up to 20%.

New effect is added for Accelerant - When dealing Burn damage, increases CRIT DMG by 15%. For each Burn type buff held, increases damage dealt by 5%

Vector gains Apathetic Resistance for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Hospice Care
keys.effect: Dead End Meltdown: If this skill killed the target, generates Incineration tiles within a 3 tile radius of the target for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Splattering Pessimism
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, increases Confectance Index by 3 points

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Dispassionate Support
keys.effect: Before using an active attack, dispels 2 buffs from the target

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Proliferating Despair
keys.effect: When an active attack deals damage against a large target, deals an additional instance of fixed damage equivalent to 15% ATK

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Unfortunate Jinx
keys.effect: When Vector is on a Burn type tile, decreases damage received by 20%, and recovers 2 Stability and 10% max HP at the end of the action

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Negative Motivation
keys.effect: If Overburn is applied on an enemy within attack range, undergoes an instance of Emergency Support, dealing Burn damage equivalent to 60% ATK and 1 Stability Damage. This effect can be activated once per turn

keys.name: Common Key - Death Knell
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / At the start of the turn, if there are enemies with Burn type debuffs, increases ATK by 8%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Depression Empathy
keys.effect:
After every active attack cooldown of Searing Finale is reduced by 1 turn. 
After a friendly unit performs a support attack that deals Burn damage, Vector gains 1 point of Confectance Index and restores HP equal to 15% of Vector's ATK to all friendly units on the field. This can be triggered up to 4 times per round.
